purpose: Test whether V104's path-dependent regressions are caused by allowing a LoadLeast initializer to move the currently schedulable function with the greatest immutable remaining critical-path rank in its request, while retaining the fixed V94 coordination guard and every V104 component/locality certificate.

v104_mechanism_diagnosis.interpretation: Instantaneous load, welfare, OCS, FaaSRank component, input-locality, and current-warm-child output-locality certificates cannot prevent a moved critical-frontier function from changing persistent container and queue state over thousands of later windows. The new treatment protects the maximum immutable remaining-work branch before any candidate ranking; it does not infer counterfactual completions.

closed_axes.density_threshold_refitting: closed by V101 and not reopened

hypothesis.primary: The residual instability is driven by moving the greatest remaining-work branch on the current request frontier. Protecting every tied maximum-rank frontier player should retain exact V94 placement on the latency-critical branch while allowing result-blind LoadLeast substitutions only on strictly lower-rank parallel branches.
hypothesis.falsification: The hypothesis fails if neither candidate passes every paired throughput and both QPR gates in all three E3 scenarios on the complete fresh E884-E886 cohort.

allowed: immutable captured DAG edges and per-function CPU/output size
current request's collected and placement-feasible player set
deterministic remaining critical-path rank already used by frozen SRPT-ready ordering
current common candidate, container, resource, queue, bandwidth, and same-window assignment state
frozen tape, SLA, reference, and V94 certificates
forbidden: completion count, throughput, latency, cost, QPR, or SLA outcome fields
future arrivals, future child placement, or future container feasibility
workload scenario label as a routing input
confirmation-seed outcomes before a training pass
information_boundary.tie_rule: Every player tied within EPSILON at the maximum remaining critical-path rank for the same request is protected; missing/nonfinite rank or a singleton frontier fails closed and is protected.

arms.current_player_safety: V104 scalar plus input and per-child current-warm downstream locality noninferiority
arms.critical_frontier_safety: protect every tied maximum remaining critical-path rank in each current request frontier

arms.current_player_safety: V104 componentwise CPU, memory, input locality, warm affinity, diversity, strict load, and per-child current-warm downstream locality noninferiority
arms.critical_frontier_safety: protect every tied maximum remaining critical-path rank in each current request frontier

candidate_mechanism.density_band: retain V104: nonterminal substitutions only at queue density >=8 and every substitution only while whole-window density <24
candidate_mechanism.critical_rank_definition: for each immutable DAG, rank(fn)=cpu(fn)/mean_node_cpu+output_mb(fn)/1000+max_child rank(child), exactly the frozen SRPT-ready rank computation
candidate_mechanism.current_frontier_definition: the complete placement-feasible player list supplied to the initializer in the current scheduling window, grouped by request id
candidate_mechanism.protected_player_predicate: missing/nonfinite rank, singleton request frontier, or rank+EPSILON >= maximum finite rank for that request frontier
candidate_mechanism.substitution_eligibility: only an unprotected player may enter V104 LoadLeast candidate ranking; protected players retain their exact V94 anchor node
candidate_mechanism.coordination_acceptance: exact frozen V94 dual window-safe routed-expert, OCS, and immutable-baseline-welfare noninferiority guard without a LoadLeast window certificate
candidate_mechanism.exact_anchor_invariant: When no unprotected initializer substitution is accepted, dispatch exactly the V94 assignment for identical current state and candidates.
candidate_mechanism.reference_policy: policy-independent offline reference construction remains unchanged

per_window: load_least gate evaluated/accepted/reason and substitution counts
performance fields retained but not opened before blind audit

selection_rule.throughput_gate_per_scenario: candidate three-seed mean is at least the matching V94 anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is nonnegative on at least two of three seeds
selection_rule.qpr_gate_per_scenario_per_convention: candidate three-seed mean is strictly greater than the matching V94 anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is strictly positive on at least two of three seeds
selection_rule.E3_winner_requires: one candidate passes all three metrics in all three E3 scenarios
selection_rule.multiple_passers: maximize the minimum relative mean QPR gain, then minimum relative throughput change, then prefer componentwise safety, then arm_id
selection_rule.absolute_formal_n20_baseline_gates: diagnostic only and never used to select a V105 profile
